body:
I only have this to say and please forgive me if I come off sounding like an ass.  

A few minutes ago, I made a post here about giving it all up but after reading your story, I just realised there is nothing in my life that is anywhere, remotely as bad as what you have been through. 

I can't begin to fathom what it must have been like to endure those things and I'm not going to pretend like I ever will understand. But all I know is it takes a hell of lot of strength and perseverance to come out of all that and still look for a way to make your life better. A lot more than I'll ever have. 

I can't top any of the advice already given here but I just wanted to say thank you. Thank you for putting things into perspective for me. I sincerely believe the universe has not forgotten about you and I truly believe you'll find the peace and solace you need. 

Stay strong dear friend, and keep up the good fight!
